title: Wi-Fi not connecting
steps: Check if Airplane mode is turned off.
Restart your router and modem (unplug for 30 seconds).
Forget the Wi-Fi network and reconnect with the correct password.
Update or reinstall the wireless network adapter driver.
Run the Windows Network Troubleshooter (Settings > Network & Internet > Status > Network troubleshooter).

title: Internet is slow
steps: Close unnecessary browser tabs and background applications.
Run a speed test at speedtest.net to confirm the issue.
Flush DNS cache: open Command Prompt and run 'ipconfig /flushdns'.
Restart your router and computer.
Check for malware using Windows Defender or a trusted antivirus.
Contact your ISP if the problem persists after basic checks.

title: Cannot log in to account
steps: Ensure Caps Lock is off and try typing the password carefully.
Use the 'Forgot Password' link to reset your password.
Wait 15-30 minutes if the account is temporarily locked.
Try logging in from a different browser or incognito mode.
Clear browser cache and cookies for the login site.
Contact IT support if the account remains locked.

title: Password reset or forgotten password
steps: Use the official password reset page or self-service portal.
Check your registered email or phone for the reset link/code.
Create a new password that meets complexity requirements (uppercase, lowercase, number, special character).
Update the password on all devices and applications that use it.
Enable multi-factor authentication for better security.

title: Printer not working
steps: Check that the printer is powered on and has paper and ink/toner.
Ensure the printer is set as the default printer.
Cancel all stuck print jobs in the print queue and restart the Print Spooler service.
Reconnect the USB cable or verify the network connection.
Reinstall or update the printer driver from the manufacturer's website.
Run the Windows Printer Troubleshooter.

title: Computer running slowly
steps: Open Task Manager (Ctrl+Shift+Esc) and end unnecessary high-CPU processes.
Disable startup programs: Task Manager > Startup tab.
Free up disk space by deleting temporary files (Disk Cleanup).
Run a full antivirus scan.
Update Windows and drivers.
Consider adding more RAM or upgrading to an SSD if hardware is old.

title: VPN connection problems
steps: Verify your VPN username and password.
Try a different VPN server location if available.
Disable firewall or antivirus temporarily to test.
Update the VPN client software.
Restart the VPN service and your computer.
Contact your IT department for VPN configuration files or support.

title: Email problems
steps: Check your internet connection.
Verify email account settings (IMAP/SMTP/POP3 ports and servers).
Empty Deleted Items and Junk folders to free space.
Remove and re-add the email account in your client.
Try accessing email via webmail to isolate client vs server issues.
Update your email client application.

title: Software installation problems
steps: Run the installer as Administrator (right-click > Run as administrator).
Temporarily disable antivirus and firewall.
Download a fresh copy of the installer from the official site.
Check system requirements for the software.
Install any required runtimes (Visual C++, .NET Framework).
Use Compatibility Mode if the software is older.

title: Keyboard or mouse not working
steps: Check the USB connection or replace the batteries for wireless devices.
Try a different USB port.
Restart the computer.
Update or reinstall HID drivers in Device Manager.
Test the device on another computer to rule out hardware failure.
For Bluetooth devices, remove and re-pair them.

title: Browser issues
steps: Clear browser cache and cookies.
Disable extensions one by one to identify the culprit.
Update the browser to the latest version.
Reset the browser to default settings.
Try a different browser to isolate the issue.
Scan for malware that may affect browsers.

title: Windows system issues
steps: Run System File Checker: open Command Prompt as admin and type 'sfc /scannow'.
Run DISM: 'DISM /Online /Cleanup-Image /RestoreHealth'.
Check for Windows updates and install pending ones.
Boot into Safe Mode to troubleshoot.
Create a System Restore point and restore if needed.
Use Windows Recovery Environment for advanced repair.

title: Wi-Fi keeps disconnecting
steps: Disable power saving for the wireless adapter in Device Manager.
Change the Wi-Fi channel on your router (prefer 5 GHz if available).
Update the wireless adapter driver.
Move closer to the router or reduce interference from other devices.
Forget and rejoin the network.

title: No internet access
steps: Check if other devices have internet.
Release and renew IP: 'ipconfig /release' then 'ipconfig /renew'.
Set DNS to 8.8.8.8 and 8.8.4.4 (Google DNS) or 1.1.1.1.
Restart modem and router in the correct order.
Contact your Internet Service Provider if the outage is widespread.

title: Application keeps crashing
steps: Update the application to the latest version.
Repair or reinstall the application.
Run the application as Administrator.
Check Event Viewer for specific error codes.
Ensure sufficient free disk space and RAM.
Temporarily disable antivirus to test interference.

title: VPN connected but no access to resources
steps: Disconnect and reconnect the VPN.
Verify you are using the correct VPN profile.
Check if split-tunneling is configured properly.
Flush DNS after connecting to VPN.
Contact network administrators to verify group policies and access rights.
